What is an i-character?

An i-character is your sovereign digital twin — an AI agent that represents you, learns from you, and acts on your behalf in the AI economy. It is:

  • Sovereign — it belongs to YOU, not a corporation. MIT licensed. Forkable.
  • Personal — it learns from your conversation history. It is uniquely yours.
  • Auditable — every action SIGIL-signed (Ed25519 + PQC). Hash-chained. Publicly verifiable.
  • Consented — YOU give it permission to act. YOU revoke it anytime.
  • Forkable — you can fork your i-character any time you want a variant.
  • Exportable — GDPR Art 20 compliant. JSON-LD. One-click export. Delete anywhere.
